page.layout: One narrow column of index entries, from top to bottom. A gap follows, then a second group of entries under a large initial M (with a small A above and m below). Page numbers (639, 750, 490, 728) sit on their own lines within the column. No running head, catchword or signature in this part.; One column of index entries, with page references at the right edge of some lines. A section letter "M" stands above the entries, with a spaced-capital entry heading beneath it.; One column of index entries with page references at the left and right edges, cut off at the left. Above the entries, the division title INDEX at full width.
page.notes: The large M carries a small superscript A and subscript m, as printed. Several entries at the right edge are cut short, so their endings are marked [?]. The page numbers 639, 750, 490 and 728 stand as their own lines and belong to the column above them. Right-edge references are fragmentary; the leading letters of several entries are cut off and are given as printed where visible. The readings "çatio", "[?]m esse", "[?]n densum" and the entry under "ACERATIO" are doubtful. The entry marked [illegible, ~1 letter] is too faint to read. The left edge of the scan is cut off, so the leading page references are fragments of the cut column and are kept as printed. The reading "503" in the entry magnitudo is uncertain. The entries on the lines beginning with a left fragment such as "4.266.437" and "337.385.503" are continuations of the entry above them.
